# Fresh Impressions Painting

> Residential and commercial painting contractor based in Granbury, Texas,
> serving Hood, Johnson, Parker, Erath and Somervell counties. Founded in 2022
> by owner Ian Rosenkranz, who has worked in the painting trade since 2015.
> Free estimates.

Contact: (817) 243-9116
Service area: Granbury, Texas and the surrounding North Central Texas counties
of Hood, Johnson, Parker, Erath and Somervell.

- [Home](https://www.fipainting.com/): Overview of services, service area and recent work.

- [Service Areas](https://www.fipainting.com/areas): The counties and towns covered.
